alt: 一家人背著包袱離開毀損農舍，路旁有舊戰車與荒田，遠方軍隊經過另一處冒煙村落。
scene_prompt: A broad historical landscape shows prolonged successive warfare harming civilians: foreground a family with bundles leaves a ruined farmhouse and trampled empty field; midground an older broken cart and weathered burned village remain from an earlier battle; far distance another army marches past a newly smoking settlement. Multiple layers of old and new damage, weary civilians, no gore, no corpses or readable banners.
